endpoints.description: Readiness plus per-source dependency status. An unreadable source appears here with its reason verbatim and does not prevent readiness.

The room list, the outcome denominator with its confidence and rationale, and per-source availability. Derived at read time from the objective set and every team's instrument declaration; never authored in code. The UI generates its routes from this response. Requirement CC-P0-007.

endpoints.summary: Composed readings for one outcome category
endpoints.description: Each reading carries all three independent axes — coverage, trust and empirical — its source team's declared instrument state, and where applicable its authored sample, setpoint target and prediction. The samples query parameter accepts hide, mark or full and defaults to mark. Requirements CC-P0-001, CC-P0-002, CC-P0-014.

examples.name: Read one room, withholding illustrative figures

endpoints.description: A single ordered answer to which sensor is worth building next, merging coverage gaps, untrusted readings, unavailable sources and unregistered outcomes. Each entry names its owning team and states why it ranks where it does; source integrity outranks coverage breadth. Entry kinds: untrusted-reading, source-unavailable, no-instrument, no-pipeline, unregistered-outcome. Requirement CC-P0-010.

Every MISSING cell and every UNREGISTERED outcome, each dated with firstObservedMissing and gapOpenDays, including this scenario's own blind spots. An instrument that reports everyone else's holes and not its own is flattering, not honest. Requirement CC-P0-011.

The full projection of the outcome space this instrument covers, its source bindings and their declared instrument state, from the shared api/handlers/capabilities module — the same surface infrastructure-manager and offer-desk expose. This is how the team reads the instrument programmatically rather than by looking at a television, and it is half of how the declared two-addresses deviation closes. Requirement CC-P0-012.

rest_exception.note: Machine-readable capability projection, shared handler module across instrument scenarios.

endpoints.description: The outcomes charter's sensor map cites this path by name as the live sensor for an outcome category. Kept as an alias, not a second model: it returns the current reading shape.

examples.name: Read a category through the charter's cited path

endpoints.summary: Compatibility alias for open-loop, grouped by room
endpoints.description: Non-NOW coverage grouped by outcome category. The charter's gap-closure loop names this path in step 1. Kept as an alias returning the current reading shape.

In-memory ring buffer of client render telemetry, consumed by the capability ladder and the frame-budget check. The only non-GET surface in the scenario; it accepts telemetry and mutates nothing outside its own buffer. Requirement CC-P0-013 permits this single exception and forbids every other write path.

rest_exception.note: Accepts client render samples into an in-memory buffer. No persistence, no upstream mutation.
